items.title: Candy Factory
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Pixel Creations presents: Candy Factory! From here we transport candies all over the world! Find out where the candies come from and learn about the technology we use to make things possible in this snowy winter season.

- Candy world to explore
- 6 HD skins
- 14 custom candy models
- Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Head Blocks
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description:
A collection of cute and clever skins. What's that they're holding over their head? It's their head? Woah, cool!

- Includes one free skin

items.title: Horse Riders
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description:
The equestrian lifestyle is the way to ride. Grab your friends and get ready for an adventure across the open countryside on your favorite horse. There’s no place quite like the open trail on a sunny day.

- Includes one free skin

items.title: Football
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description:
Are you a football fan? Pick up these skins and sport your favorite football look. Touchdown!

- Includes one free skin

items.title: Pride of Warriors
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Ninjas and samurais. What do they have in common? They are warriors! And warriors pride themselves in their devotion to art! Are you a warrior?

- 20 roleplay skins!
- Japanese attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Vibrant Creatures
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Bring a splash of color into your world with this unique skin pack of eye-catching characters. Each skin contains a handful of vibrant and wacky colors for anyone looking to turn heads.

- Includes 8 radiant skins

- All the colors of the rainbow represented

- By LuxStudios & Pathway Studios

items.title: HIVEMIND
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Must. Follow. Queen's. Orders. Unite your fellow drones and defend your colony and hive from outsiders with this skin pack of alien soldiers. Will you be the one to follow those orders or the one to give them?

- Includes 10 sci-fi themed skins!
- Choose from a variety of soldiers with different duties
- By Drzzter & Pathway Studios

items.title: Clash of Kingdoms II
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
It's good versus evil in this medieval-themed skin pack of popular heroes and villains from fantasy lore. Will you rise to the occasion and join the light side as a wizard or sacred knight, or will the dark side take the edge with their lich and black knight?

- Includes 5 good and 5 evil skins
- A variety of classes to choose from for everyone
- By Thezi & Pathway Studios

items.title: Ice Age Survival
items.creator: Atheris Games
items.description:
Humans have entered the Ice Age, a time of freezing cold temperatures and dangerous creatures around every corner. Snowstorms create a challenge for you and your tribe to survive this brave new world. Use the resources around you to survive.

+ Custom snowstorm & temperature gameplay
+ New and unique creatures from the Ice Age
+ 6 caveman skins
+ By Atheris Games

items.title: Survival Bundle
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Choose the survival spawn you’d like to use and start your adventure! Build a city around your castle, hide in a secret bunker or repair a shipwreck, or maybe even expand your treehouse?

+ Secret bunker spawn
+ Shipwreck spawn
+ Treehouse spawn
+ Castle spawn
+ Bandits camp spawn

items.title: Immersion: London
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Immerse yourself in the home town of the Big Ben! Take the tube to the Tower of London, Buckingham Palace, or Westminster. Explore the city, race your friends in a car, or decorate your apartment with furniture, there’s lots of things to do in London!

+ 6 iconic sights!
+ 20+ vehicles
+ 2 Minigames
+ 10 Skins

Top secret: There's a hidden spybase!

items.title: Wonderland
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Welcome to your own Wonderland!
Fall into a magical story with this teen skin pack filled with adorable & mystical skins! Based on Lewis Caroll's Alice in Wonderland, Jump into Alicia's shoes, or hop around like Voyage rabbit! Everything is possible in your own imagination! 

+ 10 skins from a wondrous place
+ 1 FREE skin: Alicia

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Astrological Signs
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Are you a Libra? Aries? Maybe a Gemini?
Astrological signs say a lot about us and our personalities. What better way to express than through your look! Put on these cute, detailed teen skins matching your astrological sign and go around looking absolutely beautiful!

- 12 adorable skins.
- 1 FREE skin: Aquarius

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Neon Hair
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to have purple, green, or red hair? Now's your chance! Be unique with vivid hair while wearing adorable outfits! 

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Look cute and match your friends!
+ Collect all colorful hair skins!

items.title: Mask ON
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Hide your identity! Teens are back in town and ready to adopt a new personality. Be careful or you can be easily fooled. These masked teens are all around town and looking to prank you! Be the coolest teen in town while showing your goofy side. Try out all these cool masks!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 mask-themed skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Space Knights
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Space Knights are sent from Earth to fight off invaders in space and block their entrance to Earth. You can be a Space Knight too, would you want to?

- 24 futuristic and cool skins!
+ 1 free skin!
- Perfect for space roleplay
- By Pixelusion and Lostduckies

items.title: College Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Change your style with these awesome and fashionable teens, who are ready to start their new student life on the college campus!

- 8 awesome skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- by Pixelusion and Smiley Team

items.title: The Primordial Ones
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
The beginnings of time, art, and space are parallel, but when the cosmos fade and galaxies disappear, when the art becomes stale and time freezes in place, which will prevail?

+ 16 skins

items.title: Sirenhead Monsters
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Siren Head monster with his friends is about catch survivors which were too thoughtless to lost in the wood. With this brand new siren head monsters skin pack you can play with friends as horrors or survivors. Choose your side and scare your friends.

+ Scary and spooky
+ Siren head monsters

items.title: The Space Among Us
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
There is a space among us, what can hide there? Play with friends as spacecraft crew members with these sci-fi based skins.

+ Unique skins
+ Impostors free

items.title: Cyberpunk Forces
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Future Sci-fi special forces

Futuristic special forces have arrived. Call your friends and play as advanced robots and special ops operators.

+ Sci-fi
+ Cyberpunk
+ Futuristic
+ 14 unique skins

items.title: CITY: Police - Roleplay
items.creator: HorizonBlocks
items.description:
Be a cop and catch the robbers in Block City or join the group of criminals to break the law. Rob a bank and escape from police to become the richest bandit. Roleplay with your friends and explore the city.

+ 5 POLICE VEHICLES (Cars with working siren and helicopter) 
+ 5 EXTRA CARS (50+ color variants)
+ DIFFERENT FURNITURE OPTIONS
+ POLICE PET 
+ 8 SKINS (2 free)

items.title: Nerdy Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
There is nothing wrong with being a little nerdy! Show off your own style with these nerdy teen fashion styles!

- 10 Nerdy themed skins
- By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Pink Sweaters
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Is your favorite color pink? Show your pride by wearing a pink sweater!

- 10 pink sweater themed teen skins!
- By Nitric Concepts
